parameters.formDescription: Upload your academic paper for validation.

parameters.completionTitle: ={{ $json.status === 'PASS' ? '✓ PAPER PASSED' : $json.status === 'FAIL' ? '✕ CHANGES REQUIRED' : '⚠ REVIEW REQUIRED' }}
parameters.completionMessage:
={{ 
$json.file + '\n\n' +

'RESULT: ' + $json.score + ' requirements passed\n\n' +

($json.status === 'PASS'
  ? 'No compliance issues were detected.\n\n'
  : $json.issueCount + ' issue(s) found:\n\n' +
    $json.issues.map(issue =>
      '• ' + issue.title +
      (issue.evidence ? '\n  Found: ' + issue.evidence : '') +
      (issue.expected ? '\n  Expected: ' + issue.expected : '') +
      (issue.detected && issue.detected !== 'NOT_FOUND'
        ? '\n  Detected: ' + issue.detected
        : '')
    ).join('\n\n')
) +

'\n\n──────────────\n' +

$json.categories.map(category =>
  (category.status === 'PASS' ? '✓ ' :
   category.status === 'FAIL' ? '✕ ' : '⚠ ') +
  category.label +
  ' — ' + category.passed + '/' + category.total
).join('\n') +

'\n\n' + $json.statusMessage +

'\n\n' +
$json.institution +
' · Policy ' + $json.policyVersion
}}
